What’s happening in India:

Diagnostics companies surged after reports of an HMPV outbreak in China and two confirmed cases in India. The ICMR reassured robust surveillance systems, with no unusual increase in illnesses reported.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
Hotels and airline stocks declined by up to 6.4% following three confirmed Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases in India. The India VIX index rose 13%, signaling increased market uncertainty. In contrast, healthcare stocks gained momentum.

nodes.text:
India's services sector expanded in December, with the HSBC Services Business Activity Index rising to 59.3. New orders increased for the 41st consecutive month, job creation softened, and input cost inflation eased. However, service providers continued raising fees.

The Indian government allocated ₹4,300 crores for the revised Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme for the steel sector. Launching on January 6, 2025, the scheme focuses on speciality and electrical steel production, supporting sectors like defence, automobiles, and electricals.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
ITC Ltd's shares fell 8.09% to ₹442.65 following the special pre-open session linked to the hotel arm's demerger.

Indian Energy Exchange (IEX) reported a record electricity trading volume of 11,132 MU in December, marking a 29% YoY growth. The Green Market surged 236% YoY, and REC volumes rose 58%.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
Exim Bank of India plans to raise $500 million via 10-year bonds, priced at 130 basis points above the 10-year US Treasury. This issuance, the first in two years, is expected to set a benchmark for future dollar fundraising by Indian NBFCs.

Waaree Energies Limited started trial production at its 5.4 GW solar cell manufacturing facility in Chikhli, Gujarat, marking a milestone in its solar manufacturing expansion.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
Hyundai Motor India announced the launch of the Hyundai CRETA Electric at the Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2025, featuring V2L, ADAS-linked regenerative braking, and fast-charging capabilities.

ITI Ltd's shares surged 19.09% to ₹544.35, driven by strong financial results and increased investor confidence amid government infrastructure spending.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
Happy Forgings Limited approved a ₹650 crore capex budget for facilities targeting power generation, marine, and aerospace sectors.

Titan Company Ltd. reported 24% YoY growth in Q3FY25, with its jewellery segment growing 26% and Watches & Wearables up 15%. CaratLane added its first international store in New Jersey.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
NCC Limited secured a ₹349.70 crore order in December for its Building Division, with a completion timeline of 32 months.

FSN E-Commerce Ventures (Nykaa) shares rose 5% intraday, closing 2.19% higher at ₹171.52, fueled by expectations of net revenue growth surpassing the mid-twenties in Q3 FY2025.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
IDBI Bank reported a 13% YoY growth in total business to ₹4.89 lakh crore, with advances rising 18% YoY and deposits up 9%.

Former temporary workers of Maruti Suzuki gathered to demand 30,000 permanent jobs and a 40% pay hike at the company's upcoming Kharkhoda plant.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd. reported a 16% YoY rise in vehicle sales in December 2024, with domestic utility vehicle sales up 18% and exports surging 70%.

Infosys postponed annual salary hikes to Q4 FY25, aligning with competitors like HCLTech and LTIMindtree, citing global demand uncertainties.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
LT Foods Limited completed the acquisition of a 17.5% stake in Nature Bio-Foods for ₹110 crore, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary.

Hero MotoCorp posted 7.5% YoY growth in sales, reaching 59.1 lakh units in 2024. Global sales rose 49%, and electric scooter sales hit 46,662 units.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
Marico Ltd. anticipates margin pressure from rising input costs and increased brand investments but remains focused on achieving double-digit growth in FY25.

India's corporate bond issuances hit a three-month high of ₹1.05 lakh crore in December, driven by strong demand from long-term investors and increased NBFC activity.

Infosys postponed annual salary hikes to Q4 FY25, citing global demand uncertainties, aligning with its last increase in November 2023 and similar moves by HCLTech and LTIMindtree.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
What’s happening globally:

Foxconn's Q4 revenue rose 15.2%, reaching T$2.13 trillion, driven by robust demand for AI servers and networking products.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
Vietnam's GDP grew 7.55% in Q4 2024, driven by strong consumption and exports, exceeding the annual target of 7.09%.

China's Caixin Services PMI rose to 52.2 in December, driven by domestic demand. However, employment declined, and sentiment weakened amid global competition concerns.

nodes.author: tradingqna
nodes.text:
Singapore's competition authority approved AMD's $4.9 billion acquisition of ZT Systems, strengthening AMD's AI and data centre position.

US President Biden blocked Nippon Steel's $15 billion acquisition of US Steel over national security concerns, leading to significant share price drops.

Gold traded below $2,640, with traders awaiting US economic data, while geopolitical tensions and central bank activity continued to provide support.
